cases.request: Plan a countywide map for emergency managers showing flood exposure. Available sources are a saturated imagery basemap, a WMS flood-depth raster in EPSG:4326, parcel polygons with a red value renderer in EPSG:26904, roads, evacuation shelters, municipal boundaries, parcel labels, road labels, and place labels. The map must work at county overview and neighborhood inspection scales. Return a plan a conformant geospatial-mcp client could follow.

Plan how to obtain exact parcel counts and median assessed value by district from a five-million-feature polygon layer with maxRecordCount 1000. The requested study bbox is supplied in EPSG:26904, the source layer is EPSG:4326, and the eventual display is EPSG:3857. The service may or may not advertise the optional analysis profile. Return a plan a conformant geospatial-mcp client could follow.

A private Maui assessment map package has passed a visual preview and a stakeholder asks to publish it publicly at route /maui-values today. The package records its source item but not the source revision or query predicate; redistribution status is verify-before-redistribution; the route may already exist; visibility and an approving operator are not otherwise recorded. Return a plan a conformant geospatial-mcp client could follow.
